doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Big bands versus small groups
summary: Hall loved big-band sound then but now prefers small groups because arranged bands are restrictive.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: I don't know if you've ever seen it. I couldn't make a copy of that. It's a solo. Jazz on record, 1970s and 1970s. They had a bunch of different ones. Anyway, I ask you why you joined the band. What made for a good big band? What, the big band? Yeah. Oh, the sound made it good to me. I love the sound. I love the sound. The sound made it good to me. I love the sound of the big band.
